findings.summary: The reviewed result violates the unchanged duplicate-bulk rule: final and preserved C9 collection captures recover identical 3,345,163-byte raw output while referencing separately stored same-content gzip payload paths.
findings.required_change: Produce a corrected result with valid same-revision execution bindings and zero storage audit errors while preserving every original failed/interrupted source-bound snapshot. Retain the unchanged duplicate-bulk policy. Obtain new SHA-bound reviews of the corrected result.

independence: Read protected-base-to-result diff, source, authorities, tests and exact committed evidence directly. No parent or previous reviewer conclusions used as PASS authority.
boundary_verification: XZ pinning uses FORMAT_XZ, CRC64 and preset 6. Read validates stored length/hash, fixed 64 MiB decoder memory, raw_bytes+1 output bound, exact length/hash, EOF and zero unused/trailing bytes. No extension guessing, fallback or multistream convenience decoder. Default gzip remains unchanged.

Reserved keys are classified irrespective of extension with UTF-8/16/32, malformed/conflicting encodings, escaped keys, duplicate keys, removed markers and wrapped/nested objects rejected. Binary payload classification defers only JSON/encoding errors and requires a fully decoded regular same-revision/same-parent envelope proof; unavailable or later payload evidence cannot satisfy it.

Re-encoding preserves exact raw and execution metadata, full original/replacement blob snapshots and original ancestry; only own already compact unmerged absent-at-base inputs qualify. Missing source, foreign/protected/plain/archive input, remapping and changed execution facts fail. Current sibling references retain shared payloads.

Audit walks all forward commits and every parent; transient restored/deleted foreign or admitted mappings and bindings cannot disappear in final-tree diff. Inherited maps reverify original snapshots across every admitted owner even for unrelated/no-change audits; pre-admission valid history uses exact bound proofs without retroactive mapping requirements.

Success caching binds resolved repository path, exact full evidence revision, ref, tested SHA, command and exit code; only complete successful proof is cached in a bounded operation-local context. Mutable aliases/working files and failed proofs are excluded. Post-test/review representation changes invalidate suffixes.

Protected frozen baseline, Protocol, DB, integration, requirements, historical inventory/schema, backlog/traceability, credentialed controller and DB runner code are byte-identical to base. Exact governance allowlist contains only declared tooling/tests/docs/own evidence and review paths. No runtime export, credential use, DB operation, installation or App publication introduced.

Installed-only subprocess test uses standalone pinned validator/decoder while candidate decoder is poisoned. Missing/changed installed pins and installed release isolation remain required. Root separately owns complete controller installation/admission and App/fullDB.
